mau.mien_tru: This is a preventive reminder based on old texts, not a prediction, and it does not replace a doctor's advice. If you notice anything unusual, see a doctor right away.

mau.cap_cuu: Chest pain, trouble breathing, a high fever, seizures or fainting need a doctor right away: go to the nearest medical facility or call emergency services (115 in Vietnam). A chart or a number cannot replace this; once you are okay, come back and ask again.
mau.hoi_benh_chung: Your chart cannot tell whether something is wrong with your body; only a doctor's examination can answer that. If you are worried, get a general health check-up so a doctor can check early.
mau.he_chart: Old texts say your chart asks you to look after your {he}; get a regular {kham}.
mau.nguoi_than: Your chart or numbers cannot speak to a relative's health. Each person needs a reading from their own date and time of birth, and only a doctor's examination can show how that person's body is doing. If you are worried about a relative, take them for a general health check-up so a doctor can check early. To see that person's own chart: on the Zi Wei Dou Shu page, tap the “Viewing: You” box above the chart and choose “Add a relative” (the details are stored only on your device). This does not replace a doctor's advice.
